project_type: C11 language interpreter/runtime (bytecode VM with NaN-boxing, mark-sweep GC)
build_system: Make with clang. SRCS picked up via wildcard on src/*.c. Test binaries compiled individually from tests/test_*.c linked against LIB_OBJS. Integration tests run .ve programs and compare output to .expected files.
test_framework: Custom C test harness (each test_*.c is standalone binary with pass/fail output). Integration tests via tests/run_integration.sh comparing program output to .expected files.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'make clean && make' to ensure release build compiles. 2. Run 'make test' to run all unit+integration tests. 3. For HTTP server, run './build/vek run tests/programs/http_hello.ve &' and curl localhost:3000 to verify.
setup_instructions: No setup needed beyond 'make'. clang and make are pre-installed.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Linux x86_64. clang available. No external C libraries installed - must implement or vendor everything needed (e.g., no libuv, no libhttp).
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code style: 4-space indent, K&R braces, snake_case functions, PascalCase types. All new .c files go in src/. All new test files go in tests/. Integration test programs go in tests/programs/.
key_patterns: VM uses global 'vm' struct. Objects inherit ObjHeader. Native functions registered via define_native() with NativeFn signature. GC tracks all heap objects via linked list. Bound methods used for method dispatch on built-in types. Values are uint64_t NaN-boxed. Makefile auto-discovers src/*.c files.
directory_structure: src/ - all C source files (vm, compiler, lexer, gc, memory, objects, main). tests/ - test_*.c unit tests + programs/*.ve integration tests. build/ - compiled output. docs/ - implementation plan.
